Playfessionals November Movers & Shakers Brunch

Sat, Nov 12, 2022 · 11:00 AM – 3:00 PM · Mr. Paul’s Supper Club

When
Sat, Nov 12, 2022 · 11:00 AM – 3:00 PM
Where
Mr. Paul’s Supper Club
3917 Market St., Edina, MN
Cost
$15 – $20

Playfessionals presents Movers & Shakers Brunch is happening Saturday, November 12, 2022 from 11:00 AM to 3:00 PM at the fabulous Mr. Paul’s in Edina.

All Twin Cities professionals, tastemakers & socialites for a beautiful Saturday of Mingling while sipping Mimosas and Munching on some of the best culinary cuisine that the Twin Cities has to offer: Mr. Paul’s Supper Club’s very own mishmash of brunch favorites.

As the dress code is always classy, be sure to arrive early and fashionable while being to Sounds by Shu.
